title: Rose Petal Cordial & Rose Petal Tea Cakes

ingredientSections.heading: Rose Petal Cordial
items: Petals from 5 large fragrant organic roses

methodSections.heading: Rose Petal Cordial
steps: Slice the lemons. With your hands mix all the ingedients together in a bowl, making sure to squeeze the juice from the lemons as you go. Cover and leave overnight at room temperature.
The next day, strain the lemonade concentrate into a jar and store in the fridge where it will keep for several months.
Reserve the well-drained solids to make the rose petal tea cakes (below).

methodSections.heading: Serve
steps: Add 2-3 Tbsps of the cordial to a glass of water and ice.
